column1: # The defaults twins — one row a pin identity tools/check-defaults.py scans (lever,
# where, value collapse the sites). `twin` is the path:line of the clause that runs
# the same model path at the default; a pin whose value already is the default's word
# may name its own clause. `none` needs a reason opening with a date, and every run of
# the check prints the count of those rows so the open gaps stay visible.
